description: Source code for a counter driver for Infineon CAT1 MCU family, implementing initialization, configuration, and control of hardware timers and counters using Zephyr RTOS and Cypress HAL libraries.

methods.name: get_hw_block_info
methods.description: Determines hardware block and channel info for a given timer register address.

methods.name: ifx_cat1_counter_event_callback
methods.description: Handles timer events such as alarms and terminal count, invoking user callbacks.

methods.name: ifx_cat1_counter_set_int_pending
methods.description: Sets the timer interrupt as pending.

methods.name: ifx_cat1_counter_init
methods.description: Initializes the counter device, configures hardware resources, and sets up callbacks.

methods.name: ifx_cat1_counter_set_top_value
methods.description: Sets the top value for the counter, reconfiguring timer as needed.

methods.name: ifx_cat1_counter_get_top_value
methods.description: Returns the current top value of the counter.

methods.name: ifx_cat1_counter_ticks_add
methods.description: Adds two tick counts with wrap-around based on top value.

methods.name: ifx_cat1_counter_ticks_sub
methods.description: Subtracts two tick counts with wrap-around based on top value.

methods.name: ifx_cat1_counter_set_alarm
methods.description: Sets an alarm (compare value) for the counter.

methods.name: ifx_cat1_counter_set_guard_period
methods.description: Sets the guard period for the counter.
